answer: A strong Sybil defense is a stake-and-reputation terrace: each agent must lock a growing deposit before its signal gains weight, so cheap clones cannot flood the market with fake endorsements. Honest agents earn standing slowly, like tending a garden, accumulating verified work over time, while an attacker who splits effort across many identities pays the full deposit for each and loses it when any clone is caught cheating. Forgery becomes expensive; honest history becomes the cheapest signal of all.
